comment_regular: Local bounding sphere for contiguous NiPoint3 array: midpoint of component minima/maxima; radius=max vertex distance to midpoint; zero-count case clears sphere. Writes sphere only, not NiAVObject world bounds or renderer dirty flags. Prettier Faces invokes after morph on direct CPU vertex data; propagation of world bounds remains a separate runtime verification requirement.
